decision: V6 remains unsuitable as a reliable conversational assistant

reported_failure.observed: Invented human age and gender, then repeated until the token limit
reported_failure.context: Two earlier Pilot v1 turns were retained. Context sensitivity is not an excuse for the failure.

observed_adapter_defects: English How are you receives Twi and an inappropriate follow-up question
The standard Twi greeting and clean follow-up receive awkward Meyɛ dɛ wording
The informal clean reply avoids the long loop but does not establish natural, reliable conversation

limitations: Development checks, not an unseen test set or a statistically powered accuracy estimate
Agent inspection, not independent native-speaker certification
The raw CPT base is not a capable-chat benchmark; better stopping is not semantic success
One sampling seed, four clean contexts; exact cause of the original loop is not isolated
Prepared task coverage is not proof of causal attribution or actual partial-epoch exposure
No weights, sampling policy, response postprocessing or production routing changed
